title: Mystical Neural Crystal Ball
description: A glowing crystal ball rests on an ornate metallic stand atop a dark wooden table. Inside the transparent sphere, a central braided cord explodes into a vibrant neural network of colorful glowing tendrils, flowers, and leaves in pink, blue, yellow, and green, with some patterns spilling onto the reflective table surface.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of a transparent crystal ball on an ornate dark metal stand on a glossy wooden table. Inside the sphere a central braided cord bursts into a vibrant neural network of glowing pink blue yellow and green tendrils intertwined with white flowers and leaves. Some of the colorful energy spills out onto the table surface creating luminous patterns and scattered white petals. Dark misty jungle background at night, magical atmosphere, cinematic lighting.
